name: Sanchi Kan
description: The Sanchi Kan, or Triple Irons in Farakai, was a three-sectioned staff that the Farakai believed to be the weapon of the gods. Chulok, a gangster who was the Farakai Chu bonded with the Rodian Lok, possessed a Sanchi Kan made of a durasteel core wrapped in Zillo Beast hide.
